findings.description: The first guard harness could not resolve next/navigation under Node and counted mocked component invocations as if they were imports. Returning a React element never invokes that component, so the original counter could not establish that fixture loading was gated.

evidence.original_failure: preview-tests.log preserves ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for next/navigation; preview-guard-tests-initial.log preserves the first resolver repair failing on module mocking of a TSX target.
evidence.original_counter_excerpt: namedExports: { RegimeV2Preview(props) { previewImports++; return props; } }; assert.equal(previewImports, 0);

findings.repair: Use the existing test loader with a bounded local resolve/load hook for Next notFound and the preview component. Count actual preview specifier resolutions, assert no resolution or query read in production/test, and assert both route sources place their sole dynamic import after the development guard. ES/EN development props remain unchanged.
findings.validation: 8/8 guard tests pass; included in the full Designer suite. Production HTTP behavior is checked separately after build.
